scope_note: Read-only prior-loan feasibility audit. Reads raw .asc only; no feature regeneration, no model rerun, no change to existing pipeline outputs.

account_client_linkage.note: An account with one owner + dispongents (145 loan accounts) links several clients to the SAME single loan, not to multiple loans. It yields no earlier->later same-client loan pairs.

conclusion.finding: ZERO clients are associated with more than one loan account in the PKDD '99 snapshot. Every loan-bearing account is owned by a distinct, unique client, and even including DISPONENT links every client still maps to exactly one loan account (827 distinct clients, all with one loan link each). Consequently there are ZERO earlier->later same-client loan pairs to reconstruct, so a previous-loan repayment feature cannot be built from this dataset at all - independent of the outcome-knowability question.
conclusion.implication: The prior-loan feature is NOT implementable in this study. There is no same-client prior-loan history to engineer. Do not allocate further work to building it; the relationship prerequisite (question 1) is not met, so the harder knowability requirement (question 3) is moot.

available_timing_fields.loan_contracted_duration_months: drive computed contracted end date only
available_timing_fields.status: snapshot A/B/C/D; A/B terminal (repaid/defaulted), C/D censored at extraction - not a known final outcome
available_timing_fields.account_open_date: present in account table; not a loan outcome date

question3_when_outcome_became_known.conclusion: The schema establishes the ISSUE date and a CONTRACTED end date (issue + duration). It does NOT record the actual completion date or the snapshot extraction date. Groups A/B are terminal snapshots; C/D are censored. A prior loan's final outcome can be treated as 'knowable at the later issue date' only by ASSUMING the loan matured on its contracted schedule and that no C/D loan is used. Counts of outcome-knowable pairs above include that assumption.

tier1_no_assumptions.description: Relationship facts establishable from IDs alone; no claim about repayment outcome.

tier2_requires_maturity_assumption.description: Usable only if one accepts the assumption that a prior A/B loan matured on its contracted schedule before the later issue date. Outcome is KNOWN only for A/B.
features: prior_loan_default_flag (prior B status, matured before issue)
prior_loan_repaid_flag (prior A status, matured before issue)

tier3_not_supportable.description: Requires info not in the schema (actual completion date, exact extraction date, or the future/current status of running loans).
features: payments_actually_made_toward_prior_loan (no per-loan event stream; trans is account-level)
prior_loan_default_status_at EXACT later issue instant (day-resolution, no intraday order, no completion date)

question4_supportable_prior_features.recommended_next_step_for_safe_addition: If pursued, implement ONLY Tier-1 issue-date and count features and a Tier-2 default flag restricted to pairs where the prior loan is A/B AND its contracted end date is before the later issue date. Document the maturity assumption explicitly. Do NOT include C/D prior loans as known outcomes.
